post.description:
Always answers the same 202 for valid phones.

400 codes: `invalid_phone`, `invalid_request`. 403: `csrf_failed`.
400 codes: `invalid_request`. 404: `not_found` (not a member of the crew).

patch.description: Any active member of the crew may update. 400 codes: `invalid_request`.

put.description: Sets the caller's own RSVP, creating their participation when missing.

get.description: Defaults: every status but `discarded`, newest first (max 500). 400: `invalid_request`.

post.description:
`url` or `title` is required. 400: `invalid_request`, `invalid_url`, `ignored_url`,
`invalid_dates`. 409: `duplicate_proposal` (+ `proposal_id`). The link preview is
`pending` in the response; it is unfurled off the request.

patch.description:
Partial edit; `est_price`, the dates and `booking_ref` accept `null` to clear them.
Editing `category` marks it as the user's choice. 400: `invalid_request`, `invalid_dates`.

post.description: The same status is a no-op. 409: `invalid_transition`.

delete.description: Only the author deletes a comment: 403 `forbidden` for any other member.

post.description:
Queues a new unfurl. 409: `refresh_too_soon` (pending, or fetched in the last 10 minutes).
404 also when the proposal has no link.

200.description: The thumbnail (WebP, at most 640 px wide)

get.description: `200 image/webp` (private, one day). 404 without a thumbnail or without access.

post.description:
Any member may open a dates decision. 400 codes: `invalid_request`, `invalid_window`.
409: `decision_already_open`.

put.description:
Writes the CALLER's answers only (`null` clears a day). 400 codes: `date_out_of_range`,
`invalid_request`. 409: `decision_closed`.

post.description:
Writes the chosen dates (default: best window #1) to the trip. 400 codes: `invalid_window`,
`no_window`. 409: `decision_closed`.

get.description: 503 `push_unavailable` when the VAPID keys are not configured.

post.description:
201 when new, 200 when the endpoint already was mine or is re-assigned to me.
400 codes: `invalid_subscription`. 429: `rate_limited` (more than 10 new per hour).

delete.description: Idempotent; only the caller's own rows are ever removed.

put.description: Partial updates are fine; unknown categories are `400 invalid_request`.

post.description: Sends the test notification to the caller's subscriptions (1 per minute).

get.description: Active seeded resorts, for any authenticated person.

delete.description: Snow reports of the resort are kept.

get.description: Cheap read of the latest report per resort (used by Today).

post.description: At least one field. 400 `invalid_request`; 429 `rate_limited` (6 per resort per hour).

put.description: Upsert on (trip, me, resort); `resort_id` null means "any / not decided".
Replaces all of my rows for the trip.
